mechanism_claims.claim_text: SARS-CoV S HR1 and HR2 form a stable six-helix bundle fusion-core complex under the tested in vitro conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: SARS-CoV S HR1/HR2 fusion core constructs
mechanism_claims.limitations: In vitro fusion-core biophysics; does not by itself quantify viral entry inhibition.

source_locator.result_locator: xml:sec=Results and discussion:HR1 binds to HR2 to form a complex; HR1 and HR2 complex is a stable alpha-helix coiled coil

mechanism_claims.claim_text: HR2-derived peptides/polypeptides inhibit SARS-CoV cytopathic-effect formation in Vero E6 cells in the fusion-inhibition assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: synthetic HR2-38, GST-HR2-38, and GST-HR2-44 against SARS-CoV isolate WHU in Vero E6 cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Assay supports antiviral entry/fusion inhibition by HR2 constructs; it is not a toxicity or hemolysis assay.

source_locator.result_locator: xml:sec=Results and discussion:HR2 inhibits SARS-CoV fusion

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The proposed entry/fusion inhibition model is that HR2 can interact with HR1 during the S-protein fusion intermediate, but this model remains an interpretation built from the bundle and CPE-inhibition data.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: SARS-CoV S-protein HR2 inhibitor design rationale
mechanism_claims.limitations: No receptor-binding, live-cell fusion-intermediate capture, or structural complex with the full viral spike was recovered locally; mechanism wording is bounded to the paper's interpretation.
